transformations: All facts below marked confidence:'corroborated' were independently stated by 3+ of the sources above during Phase 1B research.
'approxLifetimeAttributePoints' is a single-sourced, derived figure (3 points × 98 level-ups) and is explicitly marked lower confidence.

No numeric breakpoint/soft-cap values are included anywhere in this file: two sources (GamerGuides and ethugamer) gave contradictory numbers for the same attributes, so none could be verified. Only the fact that a breakpoints/diminishing-returns mechanic is community-believed to exist is recorded, in knownUnknowns.

approxLifetimeAttributePoints.note: 3 points/level × 98 level-ups (level 1→99). Stated outright by ethugamer; consistent with the corroborated per-level rate but not independently double-confirmed as a total.

Might.primary: Increases Attack Power / base physical damage scaling

Luck.secondary: Disputed — some sources say Speed, one says increased status-effect (Burn/Mark/Stun) chance

criticalHitDamageModifier.description: Critical hits deal a flat +50% damage, independent of attribute investment.

knownUnknowns: Exact numeric soft-cap / breakpoint values per attribute — two sources gave contradictory numbers, so none are treated as fact here.
Whether individual characters have unique base-stat growth curves, or all six share the same underlying formula — undocumented either way in every source checked.
Any exact damage or critical-hit formula combining attributes, weapon scaling, and level numerically — not publicly documented anywhere found in Phase 1B research.
Whether the +3 points/level rate ever changes at very high levels — no source reports a change, but this was not exhaustively verified level-by-level.
